high_level_description: This image appears to be a screenshot from an Instagram post by the user "phoebegates," who has verified status, as indicated by the checkmark next to their username. The post was made 15 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The main content of the post is a promotional message about the premiere of a series called "Everybody's Fight: An In Bloom Series for Reproductive Freedom." The text indicates that the series is now available on YouTube. The image itself shows three individuals sitting in what looks like a theater or auditorium.
